desc: These shotguns feature a spur hammer, transfer bar action and an integral safety that prevents the action from opening or closing when the hammer is cocked. This makes them perfect for beginners, especially the smaller and lighter youth models which feature a shortened stock and barrel. Brass bead front sights, satin oil finished exotic hardwoods, straight stock with pistol grip, sling swivels installed, ambidextrous operation, low profile serrated hammer.
